title: quamoclit acutangula
intro: Quamoclit acutangula, commonly known as the "five-angle caltrop" or "prickly caltrop," is a flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Quamoclit acutangula include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which may help in alleviating symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
